description: Delete one of the person's lists for good. It disappears for them and for readers and cannot be brought back. Refused for Inbox. Only after the person asks to delete that exact list by name; offer archive_list when they may want it back.

confirmTitle.description: The list's exact title, after the person confirms deleting it. A different title deletes nothing.

list.description: Which list: slug, exact title, or id. Must match exactly one list or the call fails.
